figures.caption: Figure 3. A section of the crystal structure of Li6PS5X showing the coordination around phosphorus and the mutual substitution of S and Br/Cl on the respective crystallographic positions. a) Li6PS5I: S1, S2, and I ordered without any significant mutual substitution. b) Li6PS5Br: minor substitution (1–2%) of S1 by Br (not shown), mutual substitution of S and Br on the S2 site (84% S, 16% Br) and on the X site (40% S, 60% Br). No quantitative information can be given for Li6PS5Cl (see text).
